summary.zh: 本次更新修复了技能徽标在重试和分支会话中丢失的问题，统一了提供方与模型设置的状态管理，并优化了异步刷新与错误处理。
summary.en: This release fixes skill badges being lost on retry and forked sessions, unifies provider and model settings state, and improves async refresh and error handling.

title.zh: 修复技能徽标在会话历史与重试中丢失的问题
title.en: Fix skill badges being lost in session history and retries

summary.zh: 技能徽标现在会跟随消息记录持久化，在查看历史、重试或恢复会话时依然保留，且分支会话也能正确读取。
summary.en: Skill badges now persist with message records, surviving history view, retry, and restore, and forked sessions can read them correctly.

details.zh: 消息记录中新增可选的技能列表字段，并通过结构化写入校验。
details.en: Added an optional skills array to message records, enforced by structured write validation.

details.zh: 历史投影在用户消息中恢复技能列表，重试和恢复路径也会保留。
details.en: History projection restores skill list on user messages; retry and restore paths preserve it.

details.zh: 分叉会话复制相同的记录，从而通过修复的投影读取技能。
details.en: Forked sessions copy the same display record, so they read skills via the fixed projection.

sources.title: fix(session): persist skill badges across history and retries
build(persistence): repin schema fingerprint for skill list fields

title.zh: 统一提供方目录与运行时模型状态
title.en: Unify provider catalog and runtime model state

summary.zh: 左侧菜单现在基于持久化的提供方目录和页面草稿，删除提供方时状态会正确收敛，并且所有辅助选择器共享同一个运行时模型目录。
summary.en: The left rail now derives from the persisted provider catalog plus page drafts; deleting a provider converges state correctly, and all auxiliary selectors share one runtime model directory.

details.zh: 删除提供方失败时卡片会保留，避免误删。
details.en: Failed provider deletes keep the card, preventing accidental removal.

details.zh: 主窗口通过现有 IPC 和同窗口事件重新广播模型变更，已挂载的弹窗无需手动刷新即可更新。
details.en: Main window re-broadcasts model changes over existing IPC and same-window events; mounted modals reload without manual refresh.

details.zh: 等待异步凭据写入完成后再刷新模型，并序列化每次刷新，防止过期快照覆盖新数据。
details.en: Async credential writes complete before model refresh; refreshes are serialized to avoid stale snapshots overwriting newer data.

details.zh: 在模型写入路径拒绝 HTTP 2xx 且含 JSON 错误的情况，确保失败不会显示为成功。
details.en: Reject HTTP 2xx with JSON error on write paths so failures never look successful.

sources.title: fix(settings): unify provider catalog and runtime model state

title.zh: 回滚 AtomGit 上传超时放宽，保持默认稳定的发布配置
title.en: Roll back AtomGit upload timeout relaxation, keeping release config stable

summary.zh: 撤销了允许 AtomGit 慢速上传的临时设置，恢复为默认的发布行为，确保发布流程的一致性。
summary.en: Reverted a temporary change that allowed slow AtomGit uploads, restoring default release behavior for consistency.

details.zh: 移除了先前为慢速上传添加的超时放宽。
details.en: Removed the previous timeout relaxation for slow uploads.

details.zh: 发布流程现在恢复为标准配置。
details.en: Release process now reverts to standard settings.
